title: Who uses the SDK, and what it talks to
caption: The SDK is a library: it runs inside its callers and talks only to the OTA booking API. Each caller picks one session mode when it creates its client. Click a node for details.

nodes.label: Hosted storefront (browser)
nodes.detail: `createVelexisClient({ baseUrl: "/api", session: "cookie" })` in `ota/frontend/src/lib/client.js`. Derived clients: `withOptions({ currency })` (boot.js) and `withOptions({ maxRetries: 0 })` for fare rules (pages/booking.js).

nodes.label: OTA admin server (Next.js)
nodes.detail: `createConsoleClient` in `ota/admin/src/lib/velexis.ts`: `secretKey = OTA_ADMIN_SERVICE_KEY`, `baseUrl = OTA_API_URL` (loopback), the staff access token, `sessionKind: "staff"`, `environment`, end-user headers. No refresh token: the admin refreshes itself (OADR-0018).

nodes.label: Third-party browser app
nodes.detail: `publishableKey: "pk_…"`, tokens held by the integrator. Its page origin must be in the key's allowed origins (`platform.api_keys.allowed_origins`), else `403 ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED`.

nodes.label: Third-party server / custom console
nodes.detail: `secretKey: "sk_…"` (refused when `document` exists). Per request `withOptions({ accessToken, refreshToken, endUser })`. A `storefront`-scoped key cannot reach the console; a `console:automation` key can, within its permissions.

nodes.label: SDK smoke tests
nodes.detail: `test/smoke/*.smoke.test.js`: token mode and server mode against the local API and the Amadeus stub, with the three `dev:seed` keys. Nightly in `.github/workflows/e2e.yml`.

nodes.label: Session (cookie / token / server)
nodes.detail: `src/internal/session.js`: credentials per mode, CSRF, the automatic refresh, the client family.

nodes.label: Caddy (storefront host /api/*)
nodes.detail: Strips `/api`, adds `X-Velexis-Edge` and `X-Velexis-Host`. Only cookie-mode calls go this way.

nodes.label: OTA API :4000
nodes.detail: `ota/backend`: validates every request against the OpenAPI document, resolves the key or edge caller, runs in the tenant schema through tenantTx.

nodes.label: OpenAPI document
nodes.detail: `ota/backend/openapi/velexis-ota-booking-api.openapi.yaml`: every operation's `x-sdk-method`, `x-error-codes`, `x-idempotent-by-design`, `x-scope`. `pnpm --filter @velexis/ota-sdk generate` turns it into the route table.

nodes.label: Contract .d.ts (frozen)
nodes.detail: `docs/velexis-sdk/sdk/src/*.d.ts`: never edited. The contract test compiles the SDK's emitted types against them.

nodes.label: @velexis/api-types
nodes.detail: Generated schema types; JSDoc imports only. The build copies the OTA part into `dist/types/api-types.d.ts`.
